import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset Visualization: Species Classification by Measurements', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Define color palette for species
palette = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#45B7D1'}

# Plot 1: Scatter plot of Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='sepal_length', y='sepal_width', hue='species', 
                palette=palette, s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Species', loc='upper right')

# Plot 2: Scatter plot of Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='petal_length', y='petal_width', hue='species', 
                palette=palette, s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax2)
ax2.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Species', loc='upper left')

# Plot 3: Box plot comparing all measurements by species
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
df_melted = df.melt(id_vars=['species'], 
                     value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'],
                     var_name='Measurement', value_name='Value (cm)')
sns.boxplot(data=df_melted, x='Measurement', y='Value (cm)', hue='species', 
            palette=palette, ax=ax3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Measurement Type', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Value (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Measurements by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xticklabels(['Sepal Length', 'Sepal Width', 'Petal Length', 'Petal Width'], rotation=15)
ax3.legend(title='Species', loc='upper right')

# Plot 4: Violin plot for petal length (most discriminative feature)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='species', y='petal_length', palette=palette, ax=ax4)
sns.stripplot(data=df, x='species', y='petal_length', color='black', alpha=0.3, size=4, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Petal Length Distribution (Key Discriminative Feature)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
